name: Potato Spelt Oat Burger
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine the mashed potatoes, spelt flour, and oat flakes in about equal amounts (1:1:1).
Mix in soy sauce and water.
Fry the onions and tomatoes in a little oil, and add to the potato mixture.
Mix in salt, pepper, savory, chili powder, and gyro spice to taste.
Form the mixture into patties. Fry lightly in a pan with a thin layer of oil until browned on both sides.
